trigger.title: On being taken hold of

trigger.title: Bored of your reading

trigger.title: Swatted

trigger.title: Back, and careful
trigger.when: About half the time it returns from a swat wary, and creeps towards the next card slowly.

trigger.title: Back, and angry
trigger.when: The other half of the time it returns furious: it reaches fast, throws three cards in a row, and may take hold of the scroll.

trigger.title: Shaking the scroll
trigger.when: It grabs the right edge of the menu and yanks the page up and down for two to four seconds, so you lose your place.

trigger.title: Asking for help

trigger.title: Nobody helped

trigger.title: Still scrolling
trigger.when: Half the time it does not let go after that, and shakes the scroll for a few seconds more.

trigger.title: Hiding
trigger.when: The other half it lets go, says this, and hides off the screen for a few seconds as if it was never there.
